source: Test fixture — a francophone deployment's own curated contraindication rules (issue #141)
description: The curated source is operator-editable, so a deployment authoring its rules in the locale its clinicians work in puts ACCENTS on the token side of the allergy/condition match, while the data entry the rule has to match is routinely typed without them. This fixture is the mirror image of the shipped drug-reference.json, whose tokens are unaccented English and whose haystacks (concept names in the current locale) carry the accents — so between them the two cover both directions of the fold.

contraindications.note: a token of nothing but combining marks - must never match
